title: WriteDreams
description: WriteDreams is a minimalistic web app for sharing creative ideas (apps, books, films, etc.) without requiring registration. Users can submit one idea every 24 hours, browse and vote for rated ideas, while unrated ideas remain hidden.

title: Live-Chat
description: A real-time chat application with Node.js and WebSockets using Socket.IO for communication. It features message persistence via SQLite, allowing users to interact in real-time.

title: Empressaria
description: Empressaria is an e-commerce website designed for efficient product browsing. It loads a product catalog dynamically from a JSON file without requiring a database.

title: Korean Character Recognition with AI
description: A machine learning project utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to recognize Korean Hangul characters from images.

title: Portal Django
description: Las bases de un portal interno desarrollado en Django (Python) para la conexión y gestión remota de una base de datos PostgreSQL.

title: Django Portal (Foundation)
description: The foundation for an internal portal developed in Django (Python) for the remote connection and management of a PostgreSQL database.
